name: web-orlina-favourites-and-about-pages-with-speech-bubble-quote
title: Orlina favourites and about pages with a serif speech-bubble quote and rainbow gradient logo mark
whatItIs: A dark page with a beige speech-bubble quote 'A seamless experience that keeps users connected with Orlina.' above a 'Your favourites' cart-style list and an About page with a long brand story beside a rainbow gradient abstract logo mark, both ending in the same footer.
whatItMeans: Personable and consistent; the speech bubble makes UX goals sound like a promise to the user.
techniques: Frame a section goal as a speech-bubble quote.
Pair a wishlist screen with the brand story page.
Reuse the same footer across all screens for continuity.

vocabulary.definition: A callout shape used for a quoted line.
Repeating the same footer for a unified feel.
